verdict.rationale: Attio's REST API (attio-docs-2, attio-docs-4, attio-docs-6) lets a developer read/write and query workspace data, which could technically be used to script a full data export, but there is no documented native 'export all data' feature, no mention of open export formats (CSV/JSON dump), and no explicit portability/exit guarantee. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export/backup feature, explicit open-format export (CSV/JSON), and any statement about data portability upon leaving the platform.
